_about: The one official colour of each Path (docs/art/path_colour_guide.md). Every place the UI shows a Path by colour reads this file through PathPalette. main = bars, borders, glows, markers; accent = the second colour (rims, a bar's highlight); text = small text on dark panels; ink = text and lines on parchment; frame = the cloth tint of the tinted card frames. Check a change with: python tools/path_palette_check.py
